profile.description: Al Hammadi Holding Company, a healthcare group, provides healthcare services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Medical Services and Pharmaceuticals Products segments. The company offers inpatient and outpatient hospital services, including accommodation, medical professional services, equipment, radiology, laboratory, and bundled healthcare offerings; and provides medical services. The company was formerly known as Al Hammadi Company For Development and Investment and changed its name to Al Hammadi Holding Company in August 2022. Al Hammadi Holding Company was founded in 1985 and is based in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
